tools.name: search_games
tools.description: Find board games whose name, in any language, contains every word of the query, best-known games first. Case, accents and punctuation are ignored, and typos are corrected (wingspn finds Wingspan; such games come last and are marked approximate). Returns each game's id, to use with get_game. Also ret

tools.description: Everything the catalog knows about one game: its names in every language, tagline, year, players, playing time, minimum age, official website, the cover image (the main one, the original edition's), the box of each other edition, name or language it is sold under (covers, each with its edition, name

tools.name: get_game_rules
tools.description: A game's rules in plain words, for one edition and language, in up to six sections (summary, setup, turn, end, scoring, variants), with who wrote each: a member, or a draft read from an uploaded rulebook in our own words and checked by a moderator (with that rulebook's files). A section the rulebook

tools.name: get_game_tutorial
tools.description: How to play a game step by step, for one edition and language: each step's text, with one image (a path on the API) or one video link, and who wrote it. `editions` lists every edition and the languages it has a tutorial in.

tools.name: list_games
tools.description: Browse the catalog a page at a time, narrowed by number of players, year, playing time, age, complexity or rating, in the order asked. Pass the returned nextCursor to get the next page.

tools.name: list_credits
tools.description: List one kind of credit with the number of games linked to each. A family is a series or a group of games that belong together. Use prefix to find a name (for example kind=designers, prefix=Knizia will not match: prefixes match the start of the full name, so use prefix=Reiner).

tools.name: get_credit
tools.description: The games linked to one credit, 60 at a time, most recently added first unless an order is given; pass the returned nextCursor for the next page. The same filters as list_games apply. An award also comes with its years and the games honoured each year. Example: kind=designers, slug=reiner-knizia, pl

tools.name: anniversaries
tools.description: Games whose age this year is a multiple of five (the catalog knows publication years, not days).

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search board games by name. Returns results with an id to pass to fetch.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
